resources.string: Keeps a local copy of received timed or view-once photos and videos after a complete download. Limits: 25 MB per photo, 100 MB per video, 1 GB total. When full, delete saved copies to make space. Expired media and media never received on this device cannot be recovered.
Photos and videos saved on this device for this account. Tap to open; hold to delete the local copy. Hidden chats are excluded from this list.
No saved media here yet. Enable saving in Message saving, then wait for a received timed or view-once photo or video to finish downloading.
Could not open this media. Refresh the list and try again.
This removes the saved photo or video from this device. Your chat and the original message stay as they are.
Could not delete the local copy. Try again.
